title: Earthily Pungent Dutch Meat Stew
description: A hearty and savory stew featuring tender meat and earthy flavors, cooked to perfection in a banana leaf vessel. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner or meal prep.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the beef, onion, carrots, potatoes, and instant yeast.
In a small bowl, melt the tempering chocolate in the microwave or over a double boiler.
Add the melted chocolate to the beef mixture and stir to combine.
Pour in the beef broth and stir to combine.
Spoon the mixture onto the center of each banana leaf, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the banana leaves over the filling to form a packet and secure with toothpicks.
Place the packets on a baking sheet and bake for 2 hours.
Remove the packets from the oven and let them cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
